win: You always know what to say... thank you for listening.
I haven't laughed like that in a long time.
It is nice to have someone to talk to in this big house.
fail: Sorry, I lost my train of thought... what were you saying?
Oh... never mind, it was nothing.
I think I am just tired today.

ana.ana: I tried a new recipe this morning. Be honest... is it too salty?
ana.you: It's perfect. Honestly, better than any restaurant.
ana.win: Better than a restaurant? Now you're just flattering me... but I'll take it.
ana.fail: You hesitated... it's too salty, isn't it? Be honest.

ana.ana: This house feels so big sometimes. It's good to hear another voice in it.
ana.you: I like it here. It feels like home.
ana.win: Home... that's a lovely thing to say. Thank you.
ana.fail: Oh... yes. Of course. It's just a house, I suppose.

ana.ana: I couldn't sleep last night. Silly thoughts. Do you ever have nights like that?
ana.you: All the time. But talking helps.
ana.win: It does, doesn't it? I feel a little lighter already.
ana.fail: Mm. Maybe I should stop troubling you with my thoughts.

ana.ana: Your camera... is it hard to learn? I always thought a photo only shows what you point at.
ana.you: A good photo shows what you feel about it. I could show you.
ana.win: I'd like that. I'm just not very photogenic...
ana.fail: Oh. I didn't mean to bore you with silly questions.

ana.ana: I haven't had my hair done in months. I must look a mess.
ana.win: Stop it... you're making me blush.
ana.fail: You don't have to be polite. I do own a mirror, you know.

ana.ana: Mrs. Dalia from next door asked if I was lonely. Can you believe that?
ana.you: You've got me around. Even if I'm terrible company.
ana.win: Terrible? You're the best part of my week. Don't tell her I said so.
ana.fail: Hm? Sorry, I wasn't sure what you meant.

ana.ana: I've been thinking about filming my cooking. Silly idea, right? Who would watch me?
ana.you: I would. And I bet a lot of people would.
ana.win: Hearing that gives me courage. Maybe I'll try one day.
ana.fail: You think so? ...Never mind, forget I said anything.

ana.ana: Don't worry about the rent, okay? I know things are hard for you right now.
ana.you: Thank you, Ana. I'll make it up to you.
ana.win: You already do, just by being here.
ana.fail: Of course... as long as you're not struggling alone.
